entry.title: New: RES23-233 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF LODGING, LOCAL TRANSPORTATION, AND A WELCOME LUNCHEON, VALUED AT $7,500, TO THE CITY FROM THE SEOUL METROPOLITAN COUNCIL, FOR COUNCIL CHAIR TOMMY WATERS, COUNCILMEMBERS RADIANT CORDERO, MATT WEYER, TYLER DOS SANTOS TAM, AND VAL AQUINO OKIMOTO, AND SISTER CITIES COORDINATOR BRAD KITSU, TO ATTEND THE CELEBRATION OF THE 10TH ANNIVERSARY OF THE SEOUL-HONOLULU FRIENDLY RELATIONSHIP IN SEOUL, REPUBLIC OF KOREA.

Latest action: Adopted.
